defects.problem: Several street cats do not each visibly enter distinct boxes, transform, and trigger other cat reactions as directed.
defects.requiredProof: Different visible street cats complete uninterrupted box entries and changes; Mocha visibly observes and reacts.

defects.problem: Latte's striped box sequence has wrong-size/incorrect-character imagery, cat/box intersections and unclear jump/landing.
defects.requiredProof: Recognizable Latte approaches the same striped box under the cafe window, clears the lip and lands inside without scale pops.

defects.problem: Obstructed Mocha/Essie framing and inadequate physical walking past Essie's intact box.
defects.requiredProof: Intact four walls are present, Essie makes space, Mocha actually passes; camera sees both actions.

defects.problem: Essie's entrance and Mocha's floof-contact rescue are not reliably shown without clipping.
defects.requiredProof: Full box visible and physically continuous cat paws, mouth/floof contact and extraction.

defects.problem: Box-dragging and transformation lack consistent prop identity and convincing physically continuous card-to-box sequence.
defects.requiredProof: Essie's SAME box stays correct size and location, dragging/contact and transformation are actually visible.

defects.problem: Box rescue shows scale changes, unsupported movement, intersection through walls and unauthorized hinged-door/walk-out staging.
defects.requiredProof: Locked action: Mocha genuinely climbs in; ears emerge; box tips; Essie tumbles onto Mocha; they embrace on the ground; reaction follows. No new hinge workaround.

defects.problem: Run-to-cafe, flap opening, Mocha's entry, and Latte's sprung three-cat tumble need continuous geometry, timing and identity.
defects.requiredProof: All characters track consistently between alley and cafe, with physically readable contact and three-cat tumble.

defects.problem: Final shared box hero shot lacks reliably demonstrated all-three-cat independent entries, proportions and emotional clarity.
defects.requiredProof: Same correct shared box fits all three; each jumps in; faces and cozy final composition visible.

defects.problem: Multiple shots have poorly framed cats, occluding foreground props, empty views, static holds or discontinuous staging.
defects.requiredProof: Start/middle/end PNGs for every render segment plus moving previews reviewed for unblocked actions, motivated tracking and no clipping.

defects.problem: Creator reported mismatched SFX. No-music review cannot prove music presence, timing, mixing or rights.
defects.requiredProof: Compare SFX cue hits to frame-accurate actions, review actual music master, verify speech ducking and music rights.

defects.problem: Review encode was 720p and is not proof of full native master correctness or 11:11 style parity.
defects.requiredProof: Verify actual native encoded 1080x1920/30 master, watch on phone with headphones against approved Episode 01.

resolutionPolicy.onlyCloseWhen: Issue-specific frames/preview clip were actually opened and inspected; full final encoded video independently reviewed.
